name: Aphelia
notes: Prism is now Aphelia, with a new icon. New Distant Star background: the real sun and moon for your place and time (moon phase, sunrise, sunset), in your Space colour. Home: drag widgets anywhere (hold to arrange), one Edit button, new Spaces can copy another Space's Home layout. Focus profiles block sites while the timer runs. To-do reminders with notifications. Weather suggests places as you type. Closing a tab no longer switches Space; clock follows your Space colour.
